verdict.rationale: The evidence names a built-in Gemini AI assistant in Gmail and a Google Meet 'Take notes for me' feature, which is a task handed off to AI. Both are one-line mentions with no description of what the assistant can do. missing for 10: documentation of what tasks can be delegated and how, coverage across Docs/Sheets/Drive, agentic multi-step task execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: New Google Meet 'Take notes for me' settings for admins and end users take effect September 29th
